info.title: DeskDesk Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the DeskDesk application — floors, desks, bookings, and knowledge articles.

x-openregister.description: DeskDesk — flexible desk booking for open-office environments

deskdesk.title: DeskDesk
deskdesk.description: Floors, desks, and bookings for the DeskDesk app.

floor.title: Floor
floor.description: A physical floor in a building. Group desks together by location so users can browse and filter by where they sit.

building.description: Optional building identifier when an organisation occupies more than one.

planImage.description: URL to a static floor-plan image, rendered next to the floor in the detail view.

desk.title: Desk
desk.description: A bookable desk in an open-office. Desks belong to a floor and a zone, and carry equipment + accessibility metadata so users can pick the right one.

label.description: Short, unique label for the desk. Convention: floor + zone + sequence (e.g. 3-East-12).

floor.description: Floor this desk belongs to. References a floor object by uuid.

zone.description: Zone within the floor. Helps users find desks near specific facilities (printer, kitchen, phonebooths).

equipment.description: Equipment available at the desk. Used as a filter in the index page.

capacity.description: How many people the desk seats. Most desks seat one; meeting desks can seat more.

accessibility.description: True when the desk is wheelchair-accessible (height-adjustable, clear floor space, accessible route).

photo.description: URL to a photo of the desk in context.

notes.description: Free-form notes for the desk (quirks, etiquette, neighbours).
notes.example: Window seat. Direct sun in the afternoon — bring a curtain clip if you need shade.

booking.title: Booking
booking.description: A reservation of one desk by one user for a time slot. Status moves tentative -> confirmed -> cancelled. Recurrence is optional.

desk.description: Desk being booked. References a desk object by uuid.

user.description: Nextcloud user id who made the booking.

start.description: Start of the booking. ISO 8601 with timezone.

end.description: End of the booking. ISO 8601 with timezone.

purpose.description: Short note about why the desk was booked. Useful for teams sharing a zone.

recurrence.description: Optional RFC 5545 RRULE for recurring bookings. Keeps the schema simple; the recurrence engine can expand on read.

knowledge_article.title: Knowledge article
knowledge_article.description: An external knowledge article surfaced in DeskDesk via OpenConnector. The canonical source lives in xWiki (or any wiki / docs system OpenConnector can target). DeskDesk treats these objects as read-only; sync is one-way wiki -> OpenRegister.

zone.description: Zone this article applies to. Matches the desk.zone enum so a desk's detail page can surface articles for its own zone.

body.description: Article body. xWiki syntax (xwiki/2.1) on the wiki side; the sync stores it as a plain string here. CnObjectSidebar's knowledge tab renders it with the wiki-syntax pass-through.
body.example: The east windows get direct sun 14:00 to 17:00 in summer...

url.description: Permalink back to the wiki page so users can edit at the source.

externalId.description: Wiki page id used by the OpenConnector synchronisation to dedupe across runs.

desk-3-east-12.label: 3-East-12
desk-3-east-12.notes: Window seat with direct afternoon sun.

desk-3-central-meeting.label: 3-Central-Meeting
desk-3-central-meeting.notes: Four-person collaboration desk near the phonebooths.

knowledge-east-etiquette.name: East zone etiquette
knowledge-east-etiquette.body: The east windows get direct sun 14:00 to 17:00 in summer. Bring a curtain clip from the supplies cabinet on floor 3. Phone calls are fine in this zone, phonebooths are a 30-second walk away.

knowledge-central-meeting-desks.name: Central zone meeting desks
knowledge-central-meeting-desks.body: Central desks 11 to 14 seat four. The cabling channel under each desk has two HDMI ports and USB-C 100W power. Camera and mic in the ceiling are wired into the in-room Jitsi instance. See the QR code on the desk.

knowledge-west-quiet-rules.name: West zone quiet rules
knowledge-west-quiet-rules.body: The west zone is the designated quiet zone. No calls, no meetings. Keep notifications muted. The kitchen is on the opposite side of the floor for a reason.
